name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Quadratic-Residue Tournament Classes
proof: For any tournament-induced class $\mathcal C(G)=\{C_a\}$, assign $C_a$ the one-point sample on coordinate $a$.  For distinct vertices $a,b$, the tournament edge between them makes one assigned sample inconsistent with the other concept, so the map is no-clashing. A class with more than one concept has no-clashing teaching dimension at least one.
